honest_summary: All four assigned files are written in full at the exact paths; no stubs or todo!() bodies. The Google providers build the @google/genai Mldev/Vertex payloads and the SDK's SSE parse loop locally with reqwest, and Mistral reproduces the @mistralai/mistralai outbound JSON (snake_case remaps), the Bearer auth header and the streaming chunk -> event mapping with the short_hash tool-call id derivation. Two mechanical fixes the lead reported (create_client Option<&str>, Value::Object wrapping of the request body) are applied. NOTE: Vertex OAuth (Application Default Credentials) is not implemented - the TS delegates it to google-auth-library; the port uses an explicit Authorization header or GOOGLE_VERTEX_ACCESS_TOKEN and names the gap in a code comment.
